title: Edit nonconformance
purpose: Correct a nonconformance's title, what happened, its source, severity or area or section.
summary: Correct the record's title, what happened, its source, severity or area. The owner or a supervisor can do this while the record is open.

tasks.title: Correct the details
steps: Say why in [[Reason]] and select [[Save changes]].

tasks.title: Change the containment or root cause
steps: These are on the investigation form: on the record select [[Record investigation]].

good_to_know: A record opened from a complaint stays linked to it, whatever source you choose.
Saving is refused unless at least one detail changed.
A correction needs a reason. It is kept with the change in the record's history.
If someone changed the record after you opened this form, saving is refused and your input kept. Reload the record and review it.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Opens from Edit details on the record, as a dialog or a full page; the title names the record, for example Edit NC-000123. Only the owner or a supervisor (the admin role included) may open it; anyone else is refused. While the optional nonconformance module is off it answers Not found.

sections.title: Fields and actions
paragraphs: The form starts with what is recorded and repeats the No patient data note: Refer to an order, sample or ticket number. Do not enter patient names or identifiers.

items.label: Source
items.description: Required. Where it came from. A record opened from a complaint can change its source like any other; it stays linked to that complaint.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required. Why the details are corrected. Kept with the change in the record's history: A reason is required.

items.label: Save changes
items.description: Saves and confirms Details saved. The history records Details edited, with the source and severity before and after when they changed.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the record without changing anything.

items.label: Refusals
items.description: Nothing changed: Change at least one detail before saving. A closed record: A closed nonconformance does not change. A supervisor can reopen it.

items.label: Stale form
items.description: This nonconformance changed after you opened it. Reload it and review the latest details. Your input is kept on the form.
